name: Dragon Horn
review:
Knights, elves and orcs on 243 ways. A wild, a Dragon Fire symbol and a scatter-triggered bonus are the main features.

The Dragon Fire symbol carries the base game, and the scatter bonus is where the bigger wins are. It's an older Thunderkick game with a classic fantasy look and simple rules. High volatility, 8,282x cap, 96.1% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
